delivery_binding.claim_ceiling: Successful request receipt binds visible read bytes; source validation, final selection and semantic use require separate evidence. Archives, tokenizer-only captures and unsuccessful dispatches are not confirmed delivery.

selection_posture: Explicit terminal model submission bound to local transport response capture and matching successful request receipt; not archive union or proof of semantic use.

selection.summary: Fixed issue #1241 by changing ZSTD_window_update() in lib/compress/zstd_compress_internal.h: window->base is now set to ip - 1 - distanceFromBase, starting the reference at 1 so index 0 is never a valid match position, ensuring the first input position is valid for a match even during first usage of the context.
